findings.finding: Comment says 'Capture the REAL retry argv' but retry_cmd = build_command(unit, workers) omits --basetemp (and --junit-xml) the retry actually ran with; a human running it on Windows gets pytest's default deep basetemp and can hit the MAX_PATH FileNotFoundError.
findings.suggestion: Soften the comment ('minus run-local temp/report paths') or add a short stable basetemp in reproduce_command.

findings.finding: assert basetemp != unit_tmp is implied by basetemp.parent == unit_tmp; fake returns SimpleNamespace while sibling tests build suite_process.ProcessResult.
findings.suggestion: Drop the redundant assert; build the fake with ProcessResult.

findings.finding: 'do not accept the retry' overstates what is enforced; the runner still passes RETRY-GREEN automatically.
findings.suggestion: Reword as an operator judgement: treat as a regression to fix, not an ordinary race.

doubt.disposition: doubt pass is conditional (migrations, async/concurrency, cross-plugin imports, irreversible ops); this diff adds one pytest CLI flag to the runner argv
